description: Complex oscillator: a modulation oscillator with a morphing wave, a final oscillator it can frequency-modulate, rectify and wave-fold, a low-pass filter, a decay envelope on both, and a scope

params.text: Sets the pitch of the modulation oscillator, 0.001Hz at the bottom of its travel to 6000Hz at the top
Sets the pitch of the final oscillator, 20Hz at the bottom of its travel to 8000Hz at the top
Sets the corner of the low-pass filter after the folding, 10Hz at the bottom of its travel to 20000Hz at the top
Sets how far the final oscillator's wave is rectified, 0% to 100%
Sets how far the final oscillator's wave is folded back on itself, 0% to 100%
Morphs the modulation oscillator's wave, stepping through sine, triangle, sawtooth and pulse with blends between them
Scales the voltage at the FM CV jack before it is added to the FM knob, 0% to 100%
Scales the voltage at the TM CV jack before it is added to the TM knob, 0% to 100%
Scales the voltage at the RECT CV jack before it is added to the RECT knob, 0% to 100%
Scales how far the modulation FM jack moves the modulation oscillator, 0% to 100%
Scales how far the final FM jack moves the final oscillator, 0% to 100%
Sets how long both envelopes take to fall: 0 to 0.3 seconds over the lower half of its travel and 0.3 to 3 seconds over the upper half, with the very top holding both wide open for a drone
Sets how much plain sine at the final oscillator's own pitch is mixed back in under the shaped wave, 0% to 100%
Sets how deeply the modulation signal frequency-modulates the final oscillator; the phase increment can go negative, so it is a through-zero modulation
Sets how deeply the modulation signal moves the wave-folding, 0% to 100%
Sets how deeply the modulation signal moves the rectification, 0% to 100%
Chooses what the final oscillator does to the modulation oscillator's phase at each of its own cycles: Off, Soft or Hard
Sets how much time one screen of the scope covers, 5ms at the top of its travel to 50 seconds at the bottom; it carries no marking and is set by dragging up and down over the display
Switches the scope between waiting for a trigger and running free

inputs.text: A rising edge fires both envelopes; with DECAY at the top of its travel both stay open and this jack does nothing
Added to the WAVE knob, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Replaces the modulation oscillator outright with whatever is patched here, taken as ±5V
Replaces the final oscillator's own wave with whatever is patched here, taken as ±5V, before the rectifying and the folding
Shifts the filter corner, two octaves down at 0V, no change at 5V and two octaves up at 10V
Added to the RECTIFY knob, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the FM knob through the trimmer beside it, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the FOLD knob, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the TM knob through the trimmer beside it, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the RECT knob through the trimmer beside it, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Multiplies the modulation oscillator's pitch through the trimmer beside it, 5V doubling it at full attenuation
Multiplies the modulation oscillator's pitch, one volt per octave
Multiplies the final oscillator's pitch through the trimmer beside it, and at full attenuation 5V takes it ten times over
Multiplies the final oscillator's pitch, one volt per octave

outputs.text: The modulation oscillator, 0V to 10V, through its own envelope
The final oscillator's plain sine, before the rectifying, the folding and the filter
The final oscillator after the rectifying, the folding, the filter and the bass mix, through its envelope

notes: randomising this module does not jump. Every knob slides to its new setting over the glide time set on the menu, and only within the span set by Random Amount.
patching the modulation EXT IN jack takes the modulation oscillator out of circuit entirely; the WAVE knob, the modulation pitch knob and its two pitch jacks then do nothing.
patching the final EXT IN jack likewise replaces the final oscillator's wave; its pitch knob and pitch jacks then do nothing, though the rectifying and folding apply as before.
menu: 2x Oversample — runs the whole voice at twice the sample rate and filters it back down
Attack Time — a slider setting how long both envelopes take to rise, 0.1ms to 100ms
Randomize Glide Time — a slider setting how long the knobs take to slide to their new values when the module is randomised
Random Amount — a slider setting how far from their current settings randomising is allowed to move the knobs
Final Frequency affected by Random — ticked, randomising moves the FINAL FREQ knob; unticked, it is left alone
Decay affected by Random — ticked, randomising moves the DEC knob; unticked, it is left alone
